newsitem.title: UK: Hungary may export 2 mln tonnes wheat in 97-98.
newsitem.headline: Hungary may export 2 mln tonnes wheat in 97-98.

text.p: Hungary may have some two million tonnes of wheat available for export during the 1997-98 season following a sharp increase in 1997 production, a local grain trader told Reuters.

"Wheat output may reach five million tonnes this year, consumption last year was between 2.7 and 2.8 million tonnes. This should leave an extra two million tonnes available for export," said Mihary Feade, a trader for the Agrimpex trade house.
He was making the comments during an informal gathering of world grain traders in London ahead of the annual session of the International Grains Council on Thursday and Friday.
He also said Hungary was hoping to export its wheat to North African nations such as Tunisia, but also possibly to Israel.
The latest statistics from the International Grains Council put the Hungarian wheat harvest for 1996 at 3.9 million tonnes.
